summary: Reproduced PR 2211's concrete unit-test counterexample against PR 2155 commit 19e9c371: the candidate always forwarded is_rebootstrap=False and broke the normal decode queue call contract. Preserved the candidate's valid disabled/unsupported CPU-backup rebootstrap fix, restored the legacy call shape when rebootstrap is false, and added a true-rebootstrap boundary test.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction of the exact review claim: expected add(req, is_retracted=False), received an additional is_rebootstrap=False keyword.

Passing-after normal decode call compatibility, explicit true-rebootstrap forwarding, candidate fallback behavior, retraction ordering, Mamba backup, and pause-generation compatibility; 48 passed and 5 subtests passed.
On one gfx950 GPU, supported MHA target and speculative draft exact-value KV backup/restore plus host-capacity boundary; 2 passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X, capability (9, 5), Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; supported MHA exact-value backup/restore tests passed. This is not DeepSeek-V4 or tp8/dp8 serving evidence.

remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4 weights and the reported tp8/dp8 distributed PD architecture were unavailable.
The MTP4/HiSparse KV-full serving race, distributed runtime behavior, semantic output, and timing remain unverified.
The single-GPU test covers supported MHA backup mechanics, not DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool.
The existing PD rebootstrap payload does not support multimodal requests.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
